highlights: Built cross-platform mobile applications with Ionic and React Native.
Bridged web experiences to mobile across iOS and Android.
experience.summary: Cross-platform mobile engineering. Shipped Ionic and React Native apps that brought web products onto iOS and Android.
story: Specialised in cross-platform mobile with Ionic and React Native, carrying web experiences onto devices that had no patience for a slow one.
Performance stopped being an abstraction here and became something users could feel.

highlights: Led frontend architecture across multiple product teams.
Expanded into full-stack work with Node.js, Express and MongoDB.
experience.summary: Led frontend architecture across several product teams, then expanded into full-stack work with Node, Express and MongoDB.
story: Promoted to lead the frontend, owning architecture across multiple product teams — decisions that outlived me and had to be defensible.
Went down the stack into Node, Express and MongoDB, and came back up having stopped seeing the layers as separate systems.

highlights: Technical lead for frontend and creative engineering.
Interactive, animated interfaces and creative coding with Three.js.
experience.summary: Technical lead for frontend and creative engineering — interactive, animated interfaces built with Three.js and custom shaders.
story: Technical lead for frontend and creative engineering, working global remote on interactive, animated interfaces — the part of the craft I would do anyway, now the part I am paid for.
Three.js, shaders, and the conviction that a page can be an experience rather than a document.

phases.title: The Beginning
phases.subtitle: Academy of Technology — B.Tech, Electrical Engineering
phases.blurb: I graduated with a degree in Electrical Engineering, but during college I stumbled upon coding and it instantly clicked. What started as curiosity soon became passion; every problem felt like a puzzle waiting to be solved. That love for problem-solving pulled me into software development, where I found the perfect mix of creativity and logic.

phases.title: Mobile Mania
phases.subtitle: Cross-platform, everywhere at once
phases.blurb: I dived deeper into development and specialised in cross-platform mobile apps. Using React Native and Ionic I built applications that brought web experiences to mobile, bridging the gap between the two worlds. This phase shaped how I think about performance, user experience and scalability across platforms.

phases.title: FullStack Madness
phases.subtitle: Down the stack, and back up again
phases.blurb: Expanded into full-stack development. Started working with backend technologies, databases and API development while keeping frontend expertise sharp — the point where I stopped seeing the stack as separate layers.

phases.title: Geeky TechLead
phases.subtitle: Creative coding as a discipline
phases.blurb: Passionate about creative coding, building interactive animations and delightful user interfaces. Always exploring new JS libraries and pushing the boundaries of what a web experience can be.
